create_superpoint_model: create a SuperPoint model with a backbone, optimizer spec, and homographic adaptation kwargs
train_superpoint_model: train the SuperPoint model using training_step with batches and image augmentation
validate_superpoint_model: validate the SuperPoint model using validation_step with batches without image augmentation
predict_keypoints_superpoint: predict keypoints from images using predict_step on the SuperPoint model
compute_superpoint_losses: compute detection and descriptor losses using _total_loss with train or val mode
